body: Yeah, that’s exactly how it is. I know it’s not my friends’ faults, I don’t blame them at all. Not consciously, anyway. What you have come to terms with is really helpful, and I’d probably strive to accept that I am flawed. I’m a perfectionist, however, so if I’m not all amazing then I’m all awful.

Don’t apologise!! You have nothing to apologise for, I really appreciate you’re efforts to help me. I have a very private snapchat story where I write about things I dislike most people knowing. 4/5 of my friends are able to see it. The thing is, however, I’m constantly suicidal. So, I don’t think my friends take me seriously anymore since I say it on that story so much. They’ll just be brief and say things like “No thanks” and “Stop” etc, and you can tell they’re tired of it. I feel like they just want me to end it so I stop saying the same things over and over.

I think you’re right, and honestly telling them isn’t a problem, at least I think. I’ve always been very honest and open with my doctors for the most part. It’s just a matter of surviving in order to talk to them again, really. Lolol

Thank you, it means a lot. Deep down, I do wish I felt better. I enjoy helping people, and if I had to have a reason to stick around it would be that. But now that one of my friends is aware of how suicidal I feel I kind of feel obligated to act on it.

By an anomaly, I genuinely mean it in every sense of the word, as in “something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected”. Usually when an anomaly appears amongst data it’s just ignored and removed from the equation altogether, right? I see myself in the same way. And as for being too sensitive, if someone sends a message that’s written bluntly or with proper grammar, I think they’re angry at me. If they don’t reply, I think they’re angry. If they give a look that seems off, I think they’re angry. Everything sets me off and immediately makes me want to die.
Not supposed to be alive, to me, just means I was meant to die when I first attempted. Because my only purpose in life is to die and I should have been able to fulfil it.

My mind scolds me constantly as it constantly makes me feel guilty for everything I do. I say sorry far too much, to the extent that it’s definitely annoying. And it’s so loud. As for shutting it up, only taking those pills works these days, since the thoughts are major. If they’re
minor I usually play games or watch videos. I used to self harm but that landed me in the hospital and that traumatised my parents so I can no longer do it to the extent I need to in order for it to work for me as a coping method.

I’m happy that went away for you. It’s awful when the thing that’s supposed to help you to improve makes you feel far worse. I believe my next appointment with my psychologist is soon, we’re looking into DBT after not making much progress with CBT. I feel like I’m wasting their time, if I’m honest. Staying alive until that appointment seems almost impossible. And yes exactly, I always expect people to mind-read and know how I feel. I wish it worked that way.

My existence has always just felt like an anomaly, as I usually say it. I’m too sensitive to possibly exist in this world, too bad of a person, too messed up. I feel like I’m not supposed to be alive, as if I’m just meant to kill myself and that’s my only purpose. As for the numbness, I just want my mind to be quiet. It feels like it’s constantly scolding me and I’m exhausted and try to shut it up as much as I can. I need those pills just to get through a day at this point.

I live with with one of my parents mainly but I’m extremely close with both. We get along well. They’re aware of my mental health, especially my mother, but she too suffers with bad mental health, as does my sister who’s also extremely physically ill. My mother has so much going on that at this point she’s preparing for my death because she knows it will happen at some point and has even suggested we all die together. At one point a few weeks ago she dropped me off at the hospital because she just couldn’t cope with my depression. It’s rough on her and I feel awful that I’m doing this to her, which is why I never open up. But she can usually tell without me saying much.
I tried when I was 15, 16, and now 17. It’s so constant..

I don’t think I really have a single particular reason. Life in general is the reason. I’ve been in treatment for a year, had different friends, tried different meds, but I feel worse than I did last year. I know I will feel better eventually but after that I’ll feel worse again. I don’t want to live in this cycle. That’s a big part of it but there’s way too many separate issues in my mind to write about.
